svg.text: FEAR PASS · LANTERN WARDEN · TRUE FORM · OPTION A
H 2.40 m · fits 2.59 m arch · ≤ 8k tris
on a stalk of spine: crown 2.40 m
the light rises from hip to head
flaps curl back; half a jaw left
ribs inside; madder only as blood
arms reach 0.45 m from the floor
The light is at head height now, not at the
hip, and it sways with a slow stride. A tall
It sees only what its own flame lights.
Darkness hides you; stay out of the swinging
